newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 extends rally as futures soar.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 extends rally as futures soar.

text.p: The UK's FTSE 100 index soared almost two percent on Tuesday as index futures surged and Wall Street firmed at the outset.
By 1419, the FTSE was up 87.5 points or 1.9 percent at 4,692.1, led by sharp gains in index heavyweights such as HSBC Holdings, Glaxo Wellcome and Lloyds TSB .

Dealers noted modest trading volumes and said the surge had been driven by a rush of speculative buying in index futures ahead of Wednesday's UK Budget. The September future was up 147 points at 4,753.

Dealers said there was talk of a tough tax-raising Budget that would bear down on consumer spending and prevent the economy overheating -- expected to prompt a "relief rally" as the government again proved its market credentials.
"I'm not surprised but it has come 48 hours earlier than I expected," said the head of equity dealing at one top U.S. investment bank.
